title: Rotting Oranges
problemStatement: You are given an m × n grid where: 0 represents an empty cell. 1 represents a fresh orange. 2 represents a rotten orange. Every minute, any fresh orange adjacent (up, down, left, or right) to a rotten orange also becomes rotten. Return the minimum number of minutes required until no fresh oranges remain. If it is impossible, return -1.
input: Integers m and n An m × n integer grid
output: A single integer representing the required minutes.
